home.title: BIODIFUL
home.subtitle:
Biodiful.org is an online scientific platform dedicated to the study of biodiversity and nature perception. 
Through surveys using photos, sounds, and videos, it explores aesthetic and emotional responses to the living world, helping to better connect human perception, ecological functions, and conservation. 

The platform is open to the entire scientific community and other partners for conducting surveys on human–nature interactions.
